translations.translatedText: # Tuesday 8.1.2019 (radio)

People with intellectual disabilities and autistic children do not always get good enough care. The number of landline phones is decreasing. The winter break of Parliament has ended. So many people visit the Oodi library that the shelves in Oodi are empty. The snowfall ends on Wednesday.
## Care for people with intellectual disabilities
![A care home nurse hands a cup of coffee to a client.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10474978)
Open image viewer
Competitive tendering has made care worse. Photo: Sasha Silvala / Yle
People with intellectual disabilities and autistic children do not always get good enough care.

The Association for Intellectual Disability and the Autism Association say that, for example, the professional skills of the carers are sometimes poor. According to the associations, the reason is that municipalities put services out to competitive tendering. Because of this, services are often ordered from the company that is the cheapest, but maybe not the best. Parents of children often feel that families are not listened to in the tendering.
The Association for Intellectual Disability and the Autism Association are organisations that want to make the lives of people with intellectual disabilities and autistic people better.
## Telia's landline phones
![Landline phone.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9760629)
Open image viewer
There are not very many landline phones any more. Photo: Derrick Frilund / Yle
The number of landline phones is decreasing. Now the telecom operator Telia says that it will stop landline phones this year. Telia wants all of its customers to use a mobile phone.
Telia has only about 30,000 customers who use a landline phone. Most of them are companies. Only a few thousand private people use a Telia landline phone.
Telia says that landline technology is already so old that it is time to end the service. Telia is one of the big telecom operators that work in Finland.
## Spring session of Parliament
![Riikka Beaiviessu.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10585892)
Open image viewer
There are 200 MPs in Parliament. Photo: Yle
The winter break of Parliament has ended. 200 MPs work in Parliament, which is the Finnish parliament.
The spring of the MPs is busy. Parliament is dealing with, for example, the social and health care reform, which means arranging social and health services.
The reason for the rush is that the parliamentary elections will be held in April. In the elections, new MPs will be chosen.
## Popularity of Oodi
![Empty shelves in the Oodi library in Helsinki.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10582663)
Open image viewer
The shelves in Oodi have emptied. Photo: Markku Pelkonen / Yle
Helsinki's new central library Oodi is very popular. So many people visit the library that the shelves in Oodi are empty.
Many people borrow books from Oodi, but return them to another library. People come to Oodi from all over the Helsinki region. They borrow up to 5,000 works from Oodi a day.
## The snowfall ends
![Snowy yard of the Savonlinna airport](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10585216)
Open image viewer
There is a lot of snow at Finnish airports now. Photo: Kalle Purhonen / Yle
Tuesday has been a rainy day. A lot of snow has fallen. Finnair cancelled flights on Tuesday because of the snowfall.
On Wednesday the snowfall ends in a large part of Finland. The temperature is below freezing across the whole country on Wednesday.
